## Added

- Toggle long-line wrapping with `W` in Changes, History, Compare, and Repository. Diff wrapping supports both unified and side-by-side layouts.
- Wrapping is off by default. Selection and copying preserve the original text without adding newlines at wrap boundaries.

Thanks to [@pierrelgol](https://github.com/pierrelgol) for the initial line-wrapping implementation in [#23](https://github.com/hiroaqii/gitframe/pull/23), which provided the starting point for this feature.
